sentence: This project studies how methamphetamine use and HIV together change brain health in people who take medications for HIV.
This project tests whether extracellular vesicles made by mesenchymal stem cells can restore immune tolerance and stop the autoimmunity of type 1 diabetes.
This project studies how cancer cells escape the immune system and tries to find ways to activate immunity against cancers.
This project tries to find out whether e-cigarette flavors and usage patterns help people with opioid use disorder on buprenorphine reduce harm.
This project studies how opioid use disorder affects mitochondria in immune cells of older people with HIV who receive antiretroviral therapy.
This project builds an imaging tool that uses a single x-ray projection to detect early lung fibrosis caused by radiation therapy.
This project tries to find out how individual RNA isoforms affect human health and disease.
This project maps how psilocybin changes brain activity over time in behaving animals using electrophysiology.
This project studies how immune cells at the maternal-fetal interface are involved in preterm birth.
This project runs high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics for DNA and RNA.
This project studies how to make glioblastoma respond better to immunotherapy.
This project offers deep learning tools and statistical analysis support to projects that focus on the neurosciences.
This project collects, stores and analyzes biospecimens and biomarker data to study risk and progression of Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to find out what epigenetic mechanism helps organs adapt to changing needs, using the avian integument model.
This project uses proteomics to find how drugs of abuse change proteins in neuronal signal transduction mechanisms.
This project tries to reprogram T-cells in the blood to attack pancreatic cancer and tests them in mouse models.
This project breeds and manages mouse and ferret models of Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency to test gene therapy and genome editing.
This project tries to find out how cannabidiol works to manage seizures in Dravet syndrome.
This project studies how advanced glycation end-products in the serum cause tendon injury in people with diabetes, using genetic mouse models.
This project looks at how ergonomics and human factors can make workplaces with robotics and automation safer.
